# Fornax Labs

> Your clients talk to you, not bots. We move the work forward. Fornax Labs is AI-first work management for client-service teams. Clients keep writing by email, WhatsApp and web forms; Fornax turns each request into an assigned, tracked task and keeps it moving, with the team approving what matters. Fornax works with mutual fund distributors today; its edition for them is called Sugamkar.

- Website: https://fornaxlabs.xyz/
- Contact: sales@fornaxlabs.xyz
- Book a demo: https://fornaxlabs.xyz/#pilot

## The product

- [Fornax Labs home](https://fornaxlabs.xyz/): The whole site on one page: the problem Fornax solves, a live demo with mutual fund distributor messages, how it works, who it's for, assignment and approvals, trust and privacy, the demo request form and an FAQ.
- Problem: client requests arrive by email, WhatsApp and web forms; someone has to read each one, work out what it needs, give it an owner, chase what's missing and check it got done.
- What Fornax does: reads every message, masks personal data before any AI sees it, splits one message into separate requests, fills in the details and matches the client record, and links a client's follow-up to the same request.
- What Fornax prepares for approval: replies to clients, questions for missing details, and its best guess on anything it isn't sure about. Nothing goes to a client without a person's approval.
- What Fornax helps track: an owner, status and due date on every request; holds and reminders; notes, files and steps; what is pending, late or waiting across the team.
- Channels: Gmail and web forms are live; WhatsApp Business is rolling out with the distributors Fornax works with.

## Who it's for

- [Sugamkar](https://fornaxlabs.xyz/#use-cases): Fornax for mutual fund distributors and wealth advisors, live today. Playbook covers SIP changes, redemptions and switches, KYC, nominee and address updates, statement and capital gains requests, and complaints.
- Early access: insurance brokers, CA and tax firms, law firms and other client-service firms can ask about fit.

- [Privacy policy](https://fornaxlabs.xyz/privacy): What data Fornax Labs collects, how WhatsApp messages and AI processing are handled, retention, and user rights.
